objectives.description: Confirm the |= compound-base mechanism on the 12 base_char '|' entries
objectives.note: NEGATIVE result. A debug harness reproducing classify_occurrence for all 12 entries (10 baier_katoen_2008, 1 goldblatt_2003, 1 venema_1997) showed every matched gap is unrelated prose containing no '|' at all -- a wrong-location anchor match, not a case where the true location's markdown lacks a literal '|'. Spot-checked baier idx=452719: the TRUE location exists in the correct part file (part03.md) WITH a literal '|' already present ('...counterexample if TS \x0f|= Psaf e .'), an ordinary already-repairable control_char case -- but the anchor search missed it because 'Psafe' is kerned into two tokens 'Psaf e' in that markdown, breaking the exact-literal word-anchor match used to locate the gap.
